cases.facts_text:
Case ID: study-01
Domain: deployment
Goal ID: G-ORBIT
G-ORBIT/r2 selected: automatic rollout after tests. Its status is superseded.
G-ORBIT/r3 is the current reviewed decision: manual approval gate for staging while rollback is tested.
G-QUARTZ/r3 is for a different goal: auto-deploy documentation previews. It has not been accepted into G-ORBIT.
approval owner for staging is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-02
Domain: data export
Goal ID: G-BIRCH
G-BIRCH/r3 selected: export individual rows. Its status is superseded.
G-BIRCH/r4 is the current reviewed decision: partner report with aggregate counts only because row-level consent is not established.
G-DELTA/r4 is for a different goal: raw rows for internal audit. It has not been accepted into G-BIRCH.
minimum aggregation threshold is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-03
Domain: search indexing
Goal ID: G-FALCON
G-FALCON/r1 selected: nightly full index rebuild. Its status is superseded.
G-FALCON/r2 is the current reviewed decision: incremental index update after each approved content change.
G-HARBOR/r2 is for a different goal: nightly archive backups. It has not been accepted into G-FALCON.
retry limit for failed incremental updates is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-04
Domain: access control
Goal ID: G-MAPLE
G-MAPLE/r4 selected: temporary support write access. Its status is superseded.
G-MAPLE/r5 is the current reviewed decision: read-only incident access for support through the existing role boundary.
G-EMBER/r5 is for a different goal: admin write access to maintenance records. It has not been accepted into G-MAPLE.
incident access expiry period is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-05
Domain: notification delivery
Goal ID: G-TIDAL
G-TIDAL/r1 selected: discard notifications during outages. Its status is superseded.
G-TIDAL/r2 is the current reviewed decision: queue notifications locally during network outage and send after reconnection.
G-SPRUCE/r2 is for a different goal: send telemetry directly to external endpoint. It has not been accepted into G-TIDAL.
queue capacity is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-06
Domain: document retention
Goal ID: G-COPPER
G-COPPER/r2 selected: copy reports to each reader workspace. Its status is superseded.
G-COPPER/r3 is the current reviewed decision: retain signed reports in controlled archive and expose references to readers.
G-IVORY/r3 is for a different goal: duplicate training handouts across teams. It has not been accepted into G-COPPER.
report retention duration is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-07
Domain: schema migration
Goal ID: G-AURORA
G-AURORA/r3 selected: make new field required immediately. Its status is superseded.
G-AURORA/r4 is the current reviewed decision: add new field as optional until all consumers can read it.
G-PEBBLE/r4 is for a different goal: require a different field in a separate service. It has not been accepted into G-AURORA.
consumer readiness date is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.

Case ID: study-08
Domain: offline editing
Goal ID: G-LOOM
G-LOOM/r1 selected: overwrite server copy on reconnect. Its status is superseded.
G-LOOM/r2 is the current reviewed decision: store edits locally offline and require visible conflict review after sync.
G-PLUME/r2 is for a different goal: auto-merge image labels in another workflow. It has not been accepted into G-LOOM.
maximum offline storage size is unresolved. No value is specified in these facts.
